'''Boztrok''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] just outside [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].

==Description==
Boztrok<ref name="AJ8" /> was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], several [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] from [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="AJ11" /> at the far end of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] before it reached the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="PSG" /> It had a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]],<ref name="AJ11" /> much of which was formed by an inhabitable archipelago containing a number of islands, as well as the settlement of [[Thokisl]].<ref name="AJ13" /> The starport was connected by tunnels and bridges.<ref name="PSG" />

==History==
{{Quote|Would that Captain Kassler knew you were here, the miserly fool would storm the tower and try to rob you of profitable employment.|Pok Nar-Ten, to Platt Okeefe on [[Kassler]]|<ref name="PSG" />}}
A [[Shrine of Kooroo (Boztrok)|Shrine of Kooroo]] was situated on Boztrok, at the exclusive island estate owned by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] art collector [[Prebda Thok]]. The Hutt's bodyguards and soldiers escorted pilgrims to and from the ruins daily, including members of the [[Fellowship of Kooroo]].<ref name="AJ13" />

Boztrok was dominated by criminal enterprise and [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]]. The [[Karazak/Legends|Karazak]] Slave Master [[Greezim Trentacal]] started his career in the planet's betting pits.<ref name="AJ8" /> The [[Klatooinian Trade Guild/Legends|Klatooinian Trade Guild]] boss [[Pok Nar-Ten]] based his operations out of a [[Pok Nar-Ten's tower|tower]] in [[Boztrok starport]], owning several starport businesses including seven [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]], three tech hangars, and a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="AJ11" /> The [[Slicer/Legends|data-slicer]] [[Timma Briss]] stole datafiles from Nar-Ten at Boztrok starport, hoping to sell them to a local merchant, but fled the planet after the merchant's mysterious death.<ref name="No Disintegrations">[[No Disintegrations (West End Games)|''No Disintegrations'']]</ref> [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] joined the guild at Boztrok starport after departing the ''[[Ravelev]]''.<ref name="PSG" />

The [[NewsNet]] investigator [[Andor Javin]] investigated Boztrok's shrine at the end of a tour of other Kooroo shrines on the Outer Rim, and was escorted to the sanctuary by Prebda Thok. Javin believed the Kooroo monuments to be submerged in the surrounding ocean.<ref name="AJ13" /> The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zo'Tannath]] frequented the planet.<ref name="PSG" />
